title: Frank black - Kick Back and Relax
htmlContent:
Frank black just dropped his visual for his latest hit song, “Kick Back and Relax”. If you’re at all familiar with Frank black, you know he’s not lacking in energy. “Kick Back and Relax” is no different in that respect. 

Frank black is staying focused and is always determined to show the world he’s different and that he has come to stay. Being a relatively new artist, we’re excited to see where he goes from here given his recent hot streak of records.

Make sure to stream and view the latest release below.
